title.narrative: Establishment of Centre of Excellence for resilience building in African Lusophone SIDS through the strengthening of research and training capacities in the areas of Marine Sciences and Biodiversity

description.narrative: The Lusophone Small Island Developing States (SIDS) in Africa - Cabo Verde, São Tome and Principe and Guinea Bissau - are both economically as language wise disadvantaged in collaborating with regional and international sciences development frameworks in their pursuit in advancing scientific capacities. Cabo Verde’s Government has in the past years emphasized the need to strengthen the Instituto do Mar capacities as a vehicle to support the country’s ambition to further develop a sustainable blue economy based of scientific evidence. In a bid to expand this ambition to fellow countries, an initiative to transform the OSCM in a regional Center of excellence is being launched for the mobilization partners and stakeholders in advancing research and training in Marine Sciences and Biodiversity of Portuguese-speaking SIDS.
